I've finished the tests, type check and edge-case probes, and I'm writing up the review. I found nothing that has to be fixed before merge. **Checks** - `pnpm test`: 3 files and 68 tests, all passing (Tabs 22, Dialog 23, Combobox 23). - `pnpm typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`): clean. - The repo has no lint or format script. **What I tested beyond the contributor's suite.** I added a temporary test file `src/zz_probe.test.tsx`, deleted it afterwards, and `git status` is back to how I found it. - **Dialog in ``:** opening it focused `In1`. Escape closed it and focus went back to `Open`. - **Tabs in ``:** ArrowRight focused and selected `B`, which became the only tab with `tabIndex` 0. End jumped to `C`. - **Combobox in ``:** ArrowDown, ArrowDown, Enter selected "Banana". After that, ArrowDown reopened the list with `aria-activedescendant` set and `aria-expanded="true"`. - **Requirements from the issue:** - Tabs: wrapping, skipping disabled tabs, Home/End, selection following focus, and only the selected tab in the tab order. - Dialog: portal, labelling by the title and description, focus moving in, focus trap, Escape, backdrop click, and focus returning to the opener. - Combobox: filtering, `aria-activedescendant` that skips disabled options, Enter or click to select, Escape closing without selecting, and "No results". All of these have tests and behave as described. - **README:** what it says about props and keyboard behaviour matches the code. - **Scope:** the change only touches `README.md`, `src/index.ts` and the six new component and test files. There are no unrelated edits or leftover files. **Nits (not blocking)** 1. **`description={0}`:** the Dialog checks `description &&`, so this prints a stray `0` without setting `aria-describedby`. My probe produced `

T

0x
`. A `description != null` check would avoid it. 2. **Focus trap is keyboard-only:** with an unstyled backdrop, clicking page content outside the dialog moves focus out while it stays open. My probe printed `focus after outside click: Outside true`. Tab then pulls focus back in. The README says "Focus is trapped", which is only fully true once the consumer styles the backdrop to cover the page. It's worth a sentence in the README, or a `focusin` guard. 3. **Tab ids:** they come from `encodeURIComponent(value)`, so the values `"a b"` and `"a%20b"` would produce the same DOM id. Unlikely in practice. 4. **Controlled Tabs with a parent that ignores `onValueChange`:** arrowing moves focus onto a tab whose `tabIndex` is -1, because the tab stop stays on the selected tab. This is allowed, but a bit odd. 5. **Unused `tests/` folder:** `tsconfig` includes an empty `tests/` folder, but the tests sit next to the components in `src/`.
